IaC & CI/CD Kompetenz – Fundiertes Know-how im Umgang mit Bicep und Azure Pipelines sowie ein gutes Gespür für effiziente und skalierbare Systemarchitekturen. Monitoring & Security Expertise – Erfahrung in der Konzeption ganzheitlicher Monitoring-Lösungen sowie solides Wissen über gängige Sicherheits- und Compliance-Standards. Agiles Denken & Produktnähe – Sich aktiv in agile Prozesse einbringen, technische und fachliche Zusammenhänge schnell erfassen und Nutzerperspektiven mitdenken. Sprachgewandtheit – Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift, um auch in crossfunktionalen Teams souverän zu agieren. Das sind deine spannenden Aufgaben CI/CD Excellence – Entwicklung und Pflege stabiler CI/CD-Pipelines für verschiedene Architekturen mit Fokus auf Performance, Testing und Deploymentqualität. Infrastructure as Code – Erstellung modularer, wiederverwendbarer IaC-Skripte und deren Integration in bestehende Prozesse unter Berücksichtigung von Sicherheit und Skalierbarkeit. Incident Management – Aufbau effektiver Monitoring- und Alerting-Systeme, frühzeitiges Erkennen von Incidents und strukturierte Problemlösung durch Logs und Metriken. Security & Compliance Umsetzung – Umsetzung relevanter Sicherheitsstandards, Durchführung von Risikoanalysen und Mitgestaltung interner Audits. Prozessautomatisierung – Automatisierung von Arbeitsabläufen mittels Shell-, PowerShell- oder Python-Skripten – mit sauberer Dokumentation und kontinuierlicher Optimierung. Betriebsoptimierung – Analyse der Systemumgebungen, frühzeitige Erkennung von Engpässen und nachhaltige Optimierung der Betriebs- und Infrastrukturkosten. Backup & Recovery Sicherheit – Planung, Überwachung und regelmäßiges Testen von Backup-Strategien zur Sicherstellung der Datenintegrität. Produktverständnis mit Impact – Tiefes Verständnis für unsere Produkte, klare Kommunikation technischer Zusammenhänge und proaktive Identifikation von Verbesserungspotenzial. Uns liegt dabei sehr am Herzen, Gehälter nachvollziehbar, fair und konsistent zu gestalten - sowohl für neue smappies als auch für die bestehende Crew. Die Spanne ergibt sich für uns aus unterschiedlichen Auswertungen und unserer aktuellen Einschätzung dessen, was wir für diese Rolle als faire Bezahlung sehen. Im Prozess sprechen wir offen und fair darüber. 🩵

review_candidates.description: About Microavia Microavia is a Dubai-based technology company developing advanced autonomous systems and drone solutions for commercial and government applications. As we continue to develop our technology and expand our product portfolio, we are looking for an experienced Chief Technology Officer (CTO) to take ownership of Microavia’s technology strategy, engineering organization, and product development. The Role The CTO will be responsible for defining and executing Microavia’s technology vision and ensuring that our engineering capabilities support the company’s commercial and strategic objectives. This is a senior leadership role combining technology strategy, product development, engineering leadership, and end-to-end project ownership . We are looking for someone who can operate at both strategic and technical levels — setting the direction while remaining close enough to the engineering organization and products to drive execution. Key Responsibilities Technology Strategy & Leadership Define and execute Microavia’s technology strategy, architecture, and long-term roadmap. Translate business and customer requirements into clear technology and product priorities. Identify new technologies and development opportunities that strengthen our products and competitive position. Advise the CEO and executive team on technology-related investments, priorities, risks, and opportunities. Product Development & Engineering Own the end-to-end development lifecycle of Microavia’s technology and products, from concept and architecture through development, testing, deployment, and continuous improvement. Ensure engineering solutions are robust, scalable, reliable, and aligned with customer and market requirements. Establish strong engineering and development processes while maintaining the speed and flexibility required in a growing technology company. Maintain high standards for product performance, quality, reliability, and technical documentation. Technology Project Management Take ownership of technology projects from planning and resource allocation through execution and delivery. Establish project scope, milestones, technical requirements, timelines, and responsibilities. Coordinate multidisciplinary engineering teams and other internal stakeholders to ensure successful delivery. Proactively identify technical and project risks and implement appropriate mitigation measures. Ensure projects are delivered according to agreed quality standards, budgets, and timelines. Engineering Team Leadership Lead, mentor, and develop Microavia’s engineering and technology teams. Establish clear responsibilities, objectives, and performance expectations. Build a culture of accountability, technical excellence, collaboration, and continuous improvement. Support the recruitment and development of strong technical talent as the organization grows. R&D and Innovation Lead research and development initiatives in autonomous systems and drone technologies. Evaluate emerging technologies and their potential application within Microavia’s products. Encourage rapid experimentation, prototyping, and validation of new technical concepts. Develop relationships with technology partners, research institutions, and other external experts where relevant. Technology Operations, Quality & Compliance Ensure the company’s technology infrastructure and engineering processes support security, reliability, scalability, and operational efficiency. Ensure technical development and products comply with applicable UAE and international regulatory requirements. Continuously improve engineering efficiency, quality control, and cost effectiveness. Customers & Stakeholders Represent the technology function in discussions with key customers, partners, and other stakeholders. Support complex customer engagements by translating operational requirements into viable technical solutions. Present technology strategy, development progress, risks, and key decisions to executive leadership and other stakeholders. What We Are Looking For Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Robotics, or a related technical discipline. 5+ years of experience in senior technology or engineering leadership roles, ideally within robotics, autonomous systems, UAV/drone technology, aerospace, or another complex hardware/software environment. Strong experience managing the full product development lifecycle and delivering complex technology projects. Solid understanding of system architecture and multidisciplinary engineering environments involving hardware, software, electronics, embedded systems, and/or autonomous technologies. Proven ability to lead and develop high-performing engineering teams. Strong project management capabilities; PMP or equivalent certification is an advantage. Excellent communication skills and the ability to translate complex technical topics into clear business decisions. Experience working with customers and senior stakeholders on technically complex projects. Strategic mindset combined with a hands-on, execution-oriented leadership style. Experience operating in a fast-growing or entrepreneurial technology environment is highly valued. Why Microavia This role offers the opportunity to take genuine ownership of the technology function within a highly specialized technology company. The successful candidate will have a direct impact on Microavia’s technology roadmap, engineering organization, product development, and future generation of autonomous systems , working closely with the CEO and leadership team from our Dubai headquarters.

review_candidates.title: Service Desk Ticket Coordinator
review_candidates.description: The Service Desk Ticket Coordinator serves as the central control point for all incoming Service Desk tickets. The role is responsible for ensuring that every ticket is accurately logged, validated, prioritized, categorized, assigned, communicated, tracked, and escalated in accordance with company procedures and service level agreements (SLAs). The Ticket Coordinator acts as the operational bridge between clients, engineers, management, and other departments, ensuring that work flows efficiently through the Service Desk and that clients receive consistent communication throughout the ticket lifecycle.  A successful Service Desk Ticket Coordinator ensures that no ticket is overlooked, no SLA is missed without proactive intervention, and every client receives consistent communication and service coordination. They are the operational heartbeat of the Service Desk, ensuring predictable service delivery, efficient resource utilisation, and exceptional client experience. Required Skills & Experience Essential Minimum 2 years' experience in a Service Desk or Service Coordination role. Experience within a Managed Services Provider (MSP) environment. Strong understanding of ticket lifecycle management. Experience working with PSA/Ticketing platforms (HaloPSA, ConnectWise, Autotask, ServiceNow, etc.). Strong administrative and organizational skills. Excellent written and verbal communication skills. Ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously. Strong attention to detail. Desirable ITIL Foundation Certification. Experience coordinating multi-tier support teams. Experience managing SLA-driven environments. Knowledge of Microsoft 365, Azure, Networking, and Endpoint Support environments. Key Competencies Customer Focus Communication Excellence Time Management Planning & Organisation Attention to Detail Accountability Problem Solving Prioritisation Escalation Management Team Collaboration Process Adherence Service Delivery Mindset Key Responsibilities 1. Ticket Intake & Validation Receive and process tickets from all approved support channels. Validate requestor authenticity and authorization. Ensure tickets contain sufficient information before assignment. Obtain missing information from clients where required. Ensure tickets are logged against the correct client, user, asset, and service. Maintain accurate ticket records at all times. Ensure no technical work commences until the ticket has been properly processed. 2. Ticket Classification & Triage Categorize tickets according to established ticket types. Assess business impact and urgency. Determine ticket priority and criticality. Identify the appropriate support tier. Route tickets to the correct team or engineer. Ensure ticket data quality and completeness. 3. Ticket Assignment & Scheduling Allocate tickets to appropriate technical resources. Schedule remote support sessions, onsite visits, and callouts. Coordinate engineer availability and workload. Manage appointment calendars and engineer schedules. Reschedule appointments where necessary. Ensure service appointments are attended within agreed timeframes. Coordinate engineer shifts and workload distribution. 4. Client Communication Management Provide professional first-response communication. Set clear expectations regarding response and resolution timelines. Follow up on client responses and approvals. Manage communication between engineers and clients. Ensure all communication is documented within the ticketing system. Escalate communication concerns where required. 5. SLA & Queue Management Monitor Service Desk queues continuously. Manage ticket queues. Identify SLA risks before breaches occur. Escalate aging, stagnant, or at-risk tickets. Drive ticket progression through all workflow stages. Ensure tickets are updated and maintained according to company standards. Maintain queue health across the Service Desk. 6. Escalation Management Escalate tickets according to escalation procedures. Monitor engineer responsiveness and ticket ownership. Coordinate major incident escalations. Ensure escalation paths are followed correctly. Track escalated tickets through to resolution. 7. Operational Coordination Act as the central coordination point for Service Desk operations. Liaise with: Engineers on all tiers NOC Resources Projects Team Key Account Managers Vendors Client Stakeholders Ensure work progresses efficiently across teams. Assist with resource allocation and prioritization. 8. Reporting & Administration Produce daily queue health reports. Compile SLA performance reports. Monitor ticket trends and recurring issues. Maintain operational dashboards. Prepare information for weekly operational meetings. Assist management with service delivery reporting. 9. Service Desk Governance & Compliance Ensure adherence to Service Desk policies and procedures. Enforce ticket management standards. Ensure engineers maintain ticket hygiene and documentation standards. Monitor compliance with communication and workflow requirements. Support continual improvement initiatives. Promote service management practices.

review_candidates.title: Ingénieur Ops Digital (F/H)
review_candidates.description: Entreprise de l'Économie Sociale, la Macif n'appartient ni à des actionnaires, ni à l'État, mais à ses sociétaires. Chaque jour, près de 10 000 salariés se mobilisent pour apporter la meilleure qualité de service à nos 5,6 millions de sociétaires et adhérents en assurances dommages, santé-prévoyance et finance-épargne. Rejoindre la Macif, c'est s'engager dans une entreprise qui innove et qui développe ses expertises sur le marché globalisé des services, notamment ceux de demain. C'est aussi s'engager dans une entreprise mutualiste, qui place les femmes et les hommes au coeur de sa stratégie de développement, notamment grâce à notre politique de ressources humaines axée sur le développement et le renforcement des compétences de nos salariés. En lien avec sa démarche de "bien vivre ensemble au travail", la Macif est un employeur inclusif et respectueux de toutes les singularités. L'ensemble de nos offres d'emploi sont accessibles aux personnes en situation de handicap. Venez rejoindre la Direction du Digital et des Systèmes d'Information du Groupe Macif en intégrant le département Solutions Digitales. Vous participerez aux évolutions du Site Macif.fr et des parcours digitaux, alignés sur les besoins de nos sociétaires et ainsi contribuerez aux ambitions de la Macif sur le Digital. Votre expertise DevOps sur les projets digitaux visera à optimiser le build, le développement et le déploiement pour améliorer l'efficacité, la qualité et l'exploitabilité de nos livrables. Vous concevrez et mettrez en ouvre des solutions CI/CD robustes et favoriserez la collaboration entre les équipes. Une maîtrise des outils DevOps (Jenkins, Docker, Kubernetes, Ansible, Terraform) est indispensable. Votre capacité à résoudre les problèmes et à innover sera un atout majeur dans notre environnement technologique en constante évolution. Votre rôle consistera à : *Partenaire Clé des Équipes de Développement : Être le correspondant privilégié des équipes de développement. Vous identifierez et traiterez les besoins des équipes en termes d'environnements (développement, tests, pré-production). Identifier, étudier et réaliser les travaux liés aux développements des équipes de build : mise en place de la supervision, élaboration des dossiers d'exploitation, rédaction des consignes aux services supports. Assurer la gestion des traitements batch, ouverture de flux, et demande de règles de sécurité en lien avec la ProdOps. *Gestion des Déploiements et Mise en Service : Être responsable de la bonne mise en production des applications. Assurer le passage en service régulier à la fin de la période de garantie, conservant la responsabilité de l'actif mais transférant l'observabilité et la surveillance quotidienne à l'équipe ProdOps. *Maintien en Condition Opérationnelle et Amélioration Continue : Assurer le maintien en condition opérationnelle des applications et infrastructures liées à Macif.fr et aux tunnels de vente. Effectuer les modifications de configuration de production ponctuelles à la demande du métier en lien avec la ProdOps, pour les sujets sans lien direct avec de nouveaux développements. review_candidates.description: Reference Number:54223:ICT Service Desk Employment Type:On Going Full Time (FT) Location:Northern Health (All Campuses) About Northern Health: As an organisation we have a clear focus on how we service and partner with our community, including our strategy of helping the community stay well when at home. With a booming, culturally rich and diverse community, and less than an hour’s drive from the CBD (still within the bounds of Myki and ride-sharing), Melbourne’s North is fast becoming the place to be. Northern Health are seeking applications from motivated and suitably experienced ICT Service Desk Technician, to join the Information Technology team. Northern Health is the major provider of acute, maternity, sub-acute, mental health, specialist, community and home-based services in Melbourne’s rapidly growing outer north. Services are provided through our six main campuses: Northern Hospital Epping, Broadmeadows Hospital, Bundoora Centre, Craigieburn and Mernda Community Hospitals Centres and Kilmore District Hospital. In addition, Mental Health Services are provided at Epping, Broadmeadows, Jacana, Preston, Mill Park, Mernda and Coburg. About the Role : We are looking for a customer-focused, Level 1, service desk technician to provide fast response and friendly ICT technical assistance for Northern Health staff. You should have very good knowledge of information technology and be able to communicate effectively to understand the problem and explain its solution. You must be customer-oriented and have the patience to deal with challenging customers as this role requires assisting pressured front-line health service staff to perform their patient care duties. This role will require you to serve as the first point of contact for staff seeking ICT assistance via the telephone, self-service or directly in person. You will be required to answer ServiceHUB calls within a defined SLA, record and resolve issues or escalate to Level 2 as required. You will also be required to provide first and second-level support for ICT requests, incidents and major outages, install new services, perform system administration tasks, work on small projects and liaise with internal customers to determine their needs and ensure these needs are being met. The IT Service Desk role is based at the Northern Health campus at Epping but may require travel and placements at other campuses as part of a roster or as requested. Hours of work will be Monday to Sunday 24x7. To be successful in this role you will have : Excellent customer focus and keen attention to detail over the phone and in person. Understanding of Active Directory and Exchange administration, computer hardware, Microsoft operating systems and Microsoft Office applications, Experience in providing support related to Entra ID and O365 Environment. Excellent communication skills (including the ability to explain technical concepts to nontechnical users), ability to deal effectively and develop personal credibility with senior management, clinicians, and other IT customers, Ability to work as part of a team and when required autonomously, Ability to empathise with the customer Good personal organisation, time management skills and motivation to continually improve. Sound problem-solving skills, Valid Victorian Motor Car Driver's Licence, Australian Citizen/Permanent Resident Next Steps : If this opportunity sounds like the next step in your career, then we would love to hear from you. Please click on the 'Apply' button and follow the prompts. For further details, please refer to the Position Description. Applications close 21 September 2026 Shortlisting will commence immediately for this vacancy. If an appropriate candidate is sourced, the advertising may close early, thus we advise you to apply right away. Why work at the Northern Health? NH offer a range of benefits which support and reward staff both personally and professionally. Our staff benefits include award winning facilities and campus partnerships, Professional development and events, an award-winning Health and wellbeing program and financial benefits. Health and Wellbeing programs, including our new ‘Thrive’ program Flexibility in the workplace and extra leave options and support An inclusive and culturally safe space Access to salary packaging & EAP Comprehensive Library services for learning, research, clinical decision-making, leisure and wellbeing (onsite and online) Work with us! Northern Health is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to attracting and retaining a diverse workforce which reflects the community we serve. Applications from Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander people, as well as applicants who are LGBTIQ+, who have different abilities, or are from culturally and Linguistically Diverse Backgrounds are encouraged.
